description: Create a new spreadsheet with one tab per entry, each tab's values loaded from a local .csv or .tsv file (delimiter from extension). Returns id, per-tab {name, sheet_id} pairs, and total cells written. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Create a Google Sheets spreadsheet with one tab per local CSV or TSV file. The verb parses and validates every file and unique tab name before creating anything, then loads the values with user-entered interpretation. Returns the spreadsheet id, ordered tab names with Google sheet ids, and the total cells written.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with id (the new spreadsheet), tabs (ordered {name, sheet_id} dicts as created; sheet_id is the numeric tab id that sheets_batch_update requests address), and updated_cells (total cells written across all tabs).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report the new spreadsheet's link built from its id (https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<id>) and the tab names. Keep each tab's sheet_id on hand for follow-on sheets_batch_update formatting requests — no addSheet-reply lookup is needed. This is a write action that creates a new document in the connected account's My Drive root.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Create a multi-tab Google spreadsheet from local csv/tsv files.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing title; tabs empty or not a list of {name, file_path} dicts; duplicate tab names; a file_path that is not absolute, does not exist, is empty, or has an extension other than .csv/.tsv. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: the error message names the offending tab entry — fix the path/extension/name and re-dispatch; nothing was created, so a retry is clean. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account.
